schema_limitations: Schema 1.0 validates the fixed control records and enums but treats repository.extensions as an opaque object; inventory completeness, owner validity, evidence path existence and private-boundary truth require human review.
The schema has no implementation-status or due-date field. Decisions describe adoption posture; prerequisites and status_note extensions carry incomplete/private verification work.
The schema does not require source revision or generation timestamp for repository profiles, so reviewed_public_revision is an extension and must be refreshed deliberately.
The schema cannot verify GitHub settings, GCP IAM, Artifact Registry, private resonate-iac or live runtime/on-chain state; those are explicitly marked unverified private boundaries.
The schema permits evidence strings and does not resolve file:line references or command claims.
